**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction on AP:

- **§1 (p0001)** affirmatively protects us: it disclaims any exclusive arrangement and states the Agreement "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties." This is better than a mere absence of a covenant.
- **§6(a) (p0025)** contains the only Customer-side prohibitions — no transfer/third-party access, no modification or derivative works, no reverse engineering, no resale or service-bureau use. These are conventional IP protections for Kubient's own platform, not restrictions on what businesses we may operate or what products we may buy or build, so they fall outside this rule.
- Targeted searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "solicit", "shall not", "Customer will not", and "will not develop" turned up nothing else relevant; the only "compet" hits were "competent substantiation" (§ on Creative) and "court of competent jurisdiction."

This sits at the **preferred** position, so no fallback narrowing or redline is needed.
